findings.message:
The test never calls `send_request_to_llm`; it only exercises its own mocks

The test is named `test_send_request_to_llm`, but line 35 calls the patched `send_request_to_open_ai` directly. The assertions check the tuple returned by the mock's side effect (line 16) and the entry that side effect appended to `CHAT_HISTORY` (line 15). Breaking the real function, such as removing its `CHAT_HISTORY.append`, changing its return value, or dropping a voice branch, would still pass.

The mock also takes ten positional arguments, but the real `send_request_to_open_ai(messages)` takes one (`aafactory/src/aafactory/fetcher/fetching.py:7`). The `send_request_to_generate_video` mock on line 11 is never reached.

Fix: call `chat_interface.send_request_to_llm(...)` with its ten parameters. Make the `send_request_to_open_ai` mock return a plain string and drop its `CHAT_HISTORY.append`, since `send_request_to_llm` already appends. Also patch `send_request_to_elevenlabs` and `send_request_to_generate_video`. Assert on the returned `("", CHAT_HISTORY, video)` tuple and on the awaited mock's messages argument.

`pytest-mock` and `pytest-asyncio` are not declared as dependencies

The test uses the `mocker` fixture and `@pytest.mark.asyncio`. The dev group declares only `pytest` and `pytest-cov`. `poetry.lock` mentions both plugins only inside other packages' optional extras. A clean install will not provide `mocker`, so pytest reports `fixture 'mocker' not found`. The local pass presumably comes from plugins installed outside the project's declared dependencies.

Fix: `poetry add --group dev pytest-mock pytest-asyncio`, which updates both `pyproject.toml` and `poetry.lock`.

The loader mock never applies, so the test reads the real TinyDB

Line 2 binds `_load_avatar_infos_for_chat` by name at import time. The patch at lines 25-31 replaces only the module attribute, so line 33 still calls the real function. That function opens `TinyDB(DB_PATH)` and calls `.get` on page-settings doc 1 (`aafactory/src/aafactory/chat/interface.py:55-60`). If that document is missing, as on a fresh checkout, `None.get` raises `AttributeError`. The loader's return value is never used, because the stub ignores its arguments.

Fix: call `chat_interface._load_avatar_infos_for_chat()` so the patch applies, or build the ten-tuple locally and drop the loader call.

Shared `CHAT_HISTORY` is cleared once with no teardown

`CHAT_HISTORY` is a module-level global. The test clears it at the start and leaves its entry behind. No other test references it today, so nothing fails now. Once a second test exists, move the clear into an autouse fixture.
